title: Balky smoothie
text: Balky smoothie. I have to have the ingredients in exactly the right proportions for this Smoothie Maker to make a good smoothie.  Otherwise, I end up shaking it and have on more than one occasion had to unplug it when it starts smoking.  It seems to be as good as a product of this cost range is available.  One just has to learn to work with it.
